title: Screening for hypertensive disorders of pregnancy with blood pressure measurements throughout pregnancy

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for hypertensive disorders in pregnant persons with blood pressure measurements throughout pregnancy.

action: Measure blood pressure throughout pregnancy to screen for hypertensive disorders of pregnancy

denominator.note: Pregnancy during the measurement year; the topic limits this to asymptomatic persons, which is not encoded (see coverage_notes).

uncomputable.needs: blood pressure measurements spread across the pregnancy period, which requires pregnancy start and end dates and prenatal visit history

numerator.note: A single in-year bp reading would not establish measurement throughout pregnancy, so this is not approximated.
